newsitem.title: USA: CPC International up on corn spinoff.
newsitem.headline: CPC International up on corn spinoff.

text.p: Shares of food company CPC International Inc rose 1-7/8 at 83-7/8, after trading as high as 85 earlier in the day, on news that it plans to spin off its corn refinming business to shareholders.
The corn refining business, while profitable, was a drag on CPC's earnings in 1996, anlaysts said.

After shedding corn refining, "I think that the company will finally come into its own in terms of recognition of the quality and growth potential that it has," said Schroder Wertheim anlayst Robert Cummins.
Cummins said he reiterated his strong buy on the stock.
"I think it's a good strategic move," added Donaldson, Lufkin and Jenrette analyst Bill Leach.
Analysts said they value the corn refining business at about $5.50 to $7.00, based on CPC's current valuation.
